```{=html}
<button class="theme-toggle" onclick="toggleTheme()" id="themeBtn">☀ Light</button>
<script>
const prefersDark = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches;
const saved = localStorage.getItem('theme');
const theme = saved || (prefersDark ? 'dark' : 'light');
document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', theme);
updateBtn(theme);
function toggleTheme() {
  const current = document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-theme');
  const next = current === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark';
  document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', next);
  localStorage.setItem('theme', next);
  updateBtn(next);
}
function updateBtn(theme) {
  const btn = document.getElementById('themeBtn');
  if (btn) btn.textContent = theme === 'dark' ? '☀ Light' : '☾ Dark';
}
</script>
```

## Welcome to My Blog

This is where I document my work, research, and thinking across quantitative finance, machine learning, and frontier market intelligence. Posts are written for practitioners — expect rigour, code, and real-world application.

---

## What to Expect

### Quantitative Finance & Markets
Deep dives into financial modelling, regime classification, factor research, and quantitative strategies — with a focus on frontier and emerging markets where data is sparse and alpha is real.

### Frontier Market Research
Original research on macroeconomic dynamics, market microstructure, and regime behaviour across East Africa, the Caucasus, and other underserved markets in the quantitative research space.

### Machine Learning
Applied ML for finance and data science — from Bayesian inference and Hidden Markov Models to production-grade pipelines and model deployment.

### R & Data Science Tutorials
Practical, code-first tutorials in R and Python. Whether you are just starting out or levelling up, these posts are built around real datasets and real problems.

### Career & Learning Journey
Honest reflections on the path from curiosity to professional practice — navigating an MSc in Financial Engineering, building open-source projects, and operating as a quant in East Africa.
